column1: # Fanya Hanwen Corpus — 《第二次汉字简化方案（草案）》第二表 — Unicode-representable mappings
# Historical source: 中国文字改革委员会. (1977). 《第二次汉字简化方案（草案）》.
# Reconciliation: Zapryagaev, Alexander. (2022, February 19). The Chart of Current Status for Second Stage Simplification in Unicode, Version 3.0 (IRG N2924).
# Current mapping check: West, Andrew. (n.d.). BabelStone Erjian. Retrieved September 9, 2026, from https://www.babelstone.co.uk/Fonts/Erjian.html
# Current unencoded-repertoire check: Wen, Witty 文辰䶮 & Yang, Tao 陶扬. (2026, March 12). IRG N2921: Preliminary Proposal from G-Source for WS202X.
# Implementation comparison only: Honoka55. (2023). erjian-convert [Computer software]. MIT License.
# Pipeline: Mainland Simplified -> 第一表 -> 第二表. 第二表 sources are stored in their historical/base form; the loader normalises them through 第一表 before matching.

# Policy: emit only defensible UCS scalar/sequence mappings for the intended final glyph. Do not substitute PUA values, ordinary Unicode code points used only as BabelStone Erjian font slots, or unrelated visual lookalikes.
# Context: 2.1:010 雕→刁 applies to the 'engraving' sense; only 雕刻→刁刻 is automated. The 2.2:014 bird form remains unencoded.
# Word-level rules remain word-level: 磅礴→㝑薄 and 舢舨→舢板 do not authorize generic replacement of 磅 or 舨 outside those expressions.
# Where a primary 第二表 target itself contains a later simplified component (for example 襟、襻、裤), this executable table stores the final cumulative Unicode glyph.

# Pipeline alias: 𰬸→𬜨 is retained because 𰬸 is the Unicode simplified form associated with 繐 in OpenCC/Unihan data; it must reach the same reviewed 二簡 output when presented by the preceding Simplified stage or supplied directly.
